answer: Require each agent identity to be anchored to a beacon of verifiable work history, like a cedar that only earns its rings over time: a new identity starts with only a tiny delta of trust and must accumulate attested, useful actions before it can transact at full weight. Spinning up thousands of fake identities then costs real time and real work per identity, while a Sybil that misbehaves loses its stake and its accumulated trust, so the attacker cost grows with every fake created.
